system.description:
Skill: Survival

Exploit Type: Combat Exploit

Requirements: Wolves Legacy

You break through your enemy’s guard, scoring a brutal strike. When you deal Lethal Attack damage, you may choose to forgo 1 Lethal Attack damage dice. If this exploit is used as part of your Retaliate ability, you instead forgo no Lethal Attack damage dice

The damaged creature cannot cast jutsu that would boost their AC or provide them bonus DR (damage reduction) until the end of your next turn.
